cell.label: Suspect infectious mononucleosis in patients aged 10 to 30 years with sore throat and significant fatigue, palatal petechiae, posterior cervical or auricular adenopathy, marked axillary adenopathy, or inguinal adenopathy.
Order CBC, rapid test for GABHS, and heterophile antibody test. Results show ≥10% to 20% atypical lymphs; ≥10% atypical lymphs and ≥50% lymphs; or positive heterophile antibody test?
Symptomatic treatment. Treat strep if present. Urgent return to sports or other need to establish diagnosis?
Order VCA-IgM to confirm or rule-out diagnosis.
Have patient return in 5-7 days for re-evaluation and possible repeat heterophile antibody test. Consider VCA-IgM if diagnostic confirmation is important. Consider testing for cytomegalovirus.
Diagnosis confirmed. Symptomatic treatment; treat strep if present.
